title: Long Diagonal Skewer
setup: Black's king on d5 and rook on a8 stand on the same long diagonal, and your bishop is one step from claiming it.
hint: Check the king along the line it shares with the rook, and see what is left when it steps aside.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is a skewer: the more valuable piece stands in front. {{Bf3+}} checks the king on d5 along the long diagonal, with the rook on a8 behind it on the same line. The king must step off the line, and after {{Kd4}}, {{Bxa8}} collects what was hiding behind it.

A pin attacks through the cheap piece at the expensive one. A skewer attacks through the expensive piece at the cheap one.
